column7: Guide to filling out your Token Metrics

1. For the Token Metrics, please fill in the lockup schedule as of the TGE Date

2. Highlighted (grey, yellow, green) cells are automatic input fields, do not modify them arbitrarily.

3. If there are any changes or modifications to the Token Metrics, please request an update through  [techsupport@bithumbcorp.com]

4. Bithumb will monitor abnormal transactions based on this Tokenomics

5. If you don't have enough space for categories  when you fill out your Release Schedule, then expand hidden columns or add a new column to the right of the R column.

6.If you don't have enough space for categories when you fill out your Foundation Wallet Address, then expand hidden rows or add a new row at the bottom of column 40.

7. Please use the same title for each category as shown in your Tokenomics
